title: Workload and request allowance
hint: Preview uses saved import settings and a bounded sample. It does not call a model.
limit_hint: Retries and review requests share this allowance. Exhaustion stops safely; increasing it explicitly allows saved work to resume.
input_price: Input price (USD per million tokens, optional)
output_price: Output price (USD per million tokens, optional)
price_hint: Prices apply to the current model and endpoint. Missing pricing or provider usage stays unknown; this is a request limit, not a guaranteed spending cap.
preview_ready: Preview ready. Token ranges are estimates; refinement may need additional requests.
bounded: Preview is limited to up to 8 files, 8 MiB per file and 2,000 directory entries. More work may remain outside this sample.
estimate: {files} files, {messages} messages; {pending} pending, {cached} cached parts. Estimated requests: {calls}; input tokens: {input}; output tokens: {output}. {cost}
usage: Latest checkpoint: {used}/{limit} requests; {seconds}s. Recorded input/output tokens: {input}/{output}; {missing} requests have unknown usage. {cost}
active: Stop the current import before previewing or changing its allowance.
invalid: Use a whole-number request allowance from 1 to 10,000 and optional nonnegative token prices.
failed: Could not read workload or save the allowance. Please try again.
